# What `main` requires before a commit may sit on it.
#
# One check-run name per line, spelled exactly as the workflow publishes it --
# including the platform suffix a matrix job appends. This file is the
# declaration; the copy that enforces is stored in the repository's branch
# protection settings, and only a token carrying `administration` scope can
# read or write that copy.
#
# The two halves fail differently and both have failed:
#
#   - a name here that no workflow produces can never be reported, so the
#     requirement is unsatisfiable and everyone who can push is pushing through
#     a bypass while the push still echoes "N of M required status checks are
#     expected". `deploy/scripts/check-required-checks.py` refuses that name.
#   - a name here that the settings do not carry is a requirement nobody
#     enforces. Nothing in this tree can read the settings, so that direction is
#     caught only by whatever pushes this file to GitHub -- which is why the
#     push is a named step rather than an assumption.
#
# Changing this list without changing the settings only moves the drift.
Check
Test
Format
Clippy
Entry Scripts Lint
Code Coverage
Bootstrap Cross-Platform Check (ubuntu-latest)
Bootstrap Cross-Platform Check (windows-latest)
Bootstrap Cross-Platform Check (macos-latest)
